scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && rm -rf dist && swc src -d dist --source-maps --copy-files
scripts.test: pnpm --filter express-cargo build && pnpm build && node dist/src/benchmark.js --check
scripts.start: pnpm --filter express-cargo build && pnpm build && node dist/src/server.js
scripts.benchmark: pnpm --filter express-cargo build && pnpm build && node dist/src/benchmark.js
